attr.title: Broforce
attr.desc: A pixel-art run-and-gun platformer with destructible stages and action-movie heroes to rescue.
attr.inst: Requires the Steam Linux edition of Broforce. Run download_depot 274190 274193 in the Steam console and copy depot_274193 to ports/broforce/gamedata. Launch Broforce to build the game on the handheld. Leave at least 3 GiB free for first-time setup.
